question: Quantas internacoes existem no banco?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_internacoes FROM internacoes;
notes: Baseline fact-table count. Expected result at 2026-05-29 baseline: 183877219.

question: Quantos obitos hospitalares ocorreram em 2020?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_obitos FROM internacoes WHERE MORTE = true AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM DT_INTER) = 2020;
notes: Mortality must use MORTE and default date DT_INTER.

question: Qual a taxa de mortalidade por sexo em 2021?
gold_sql: SELECT i.SEXO, COUNT(*) AS internacoes, SUM(CASE WHEN i.MORTE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS obitos, CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN i.MORTE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS taxa_mortalidade FROM internacoes i WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i.DT_INTER) = 2021 GROUP BY i.SEXO ORDER BY i.SEXO;
notes: Rate requires numerator and denominator; fact table has observed SEXO values 1 and 3.

question: Quais os 10 CIDs principais com mais internacoes?
gold_sql: SELECT i.DIAG_PRINC, c.DESCRICAO, COUNT(*) AS total_internacoes FROM internacoes i LEFT JOIN cid c ON i.DIAG_PRINC = c.CID GROUP BY i.DIAG_PRINC, c.DESCRICAO ORDER BY total_internacoes DESC LIMIT 10;
notes: Diagnosis defaults to DIAG_PRINC, not CID_MORTE or secondary diagnoses.

question: Qual a media de permanencia por ano?
gold_sql: SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM DT_INTER) AS ano, AVG(DIAS_PERM) AS media_permanencia FROM internacoes GROUP BY ano ORDER BY ano;
notes: Length of stay must use DIAS_PERM, not recomputed date_diff.

question: Quais municipios de residencia tiveram mais internacoes?
gold_sql: SELECT i.MUNIC_RES, m.NO_MUNICIPIO, COUNT(*) AS total_internacoes FROM internacoes i LEFT JOIN municipios m ON i.MUNIC_RES = m.CO_MUNICIPIO_6D GROUP BY i.MUNIC_RES, m.NO_MUNICIPIO ORDER BY total_internacoes DESC LIMIT 10;
notes: Default municipality scope is patient residence unless user asks hospital location.

question: Quais hospitais tiveram maior valor total pago?
gold_sql: SELECT i.CNES, h.NOME, SUM(i.VAL_TOT) AS valor_total FROM internacoes i LEFT JOIN hospital h ON i.CNES = h.CNES GROUP BY i.CNES, h.NOME ORDER BY valor_total DESC LIMIT 10;
notes: Hospital joins through CNES; total value uses VAL_TOT.

question: Quais procedimentos foram mais realizados?
gold_sql: SELECT ip.PROC_REA, p.PROC_REA_DESCRICAO, COUNT(*) AS total_procedimentos FROM internacao_procedimento ip LEFT JOIN procedimentos p ON ip.PROC_REA = p.PROC_REA GROUP BY ip.PROC_REA, p.PROC_REA_DESCRICAO ORDER BY total_procedimentos DESC LIMIT 10;
notes: Procedure questions use the procedure fact table, not only internacoes.

question: Qual o PIB per capita por municipio em 2021?
gold_sql: SELECT s.CO_MUNICIPIO_6D, m.NO_MUNICIPIO, s.VL_PIB_PERCAPITA FROM socioeconomico s LEFT JOIN municipios m ON s.CO_MUNICIPIO_6D = m.CO_MUNICIPIO_6D WHERE s.NU_ANO = 2021 ORDER BY s.VL_PIB_PERCAPITA DESC LIMIT 10;
